'''Danison Varik''' was a [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] chief scientist who worked for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
In [[3640 BBY]], Varik began producing prototype [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in a secure facility and use them to help the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] in their [[Battle of Corellia|conquest]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. When Republic forces were able to break down the prison-grade vault doors, Varik activated his droids to eliminate them. After his droids were defeated, Varik confessed to being a collaborator and was taken into custody.<ref name="Research and Development" />
